title: SeatRead
description: The one record of GET /v1/seat (docs/design/m0/08 "Supervisor seat", adc seat status): the controller's supervisor seat, its holder, its version (what --expect names; 0 before its first event) and its pending handover request. The seat is the controller's, outside any project: it is read only under an every-project read, like its events.

holder.description: The supervisor holding the seat; null while it is free.

grace_seconds.description: The least time a forced handover leaves the holder, from the request's recorded time (authority.SeatMinGrace).

handover.description: The pending handover request; null when there is none.

force_after.description: When the request wins; null: it only asks.
